signatures.description: Implement continuous collision detection for a moving capsule (segment p0 to p1 plus radius, with linear translation and interpolated angular motion) against a static triangle soup, using conservative advancement with a Lipschitz bound on the signed distance so no time of impact is skipped even at 10000 units/s with 1/60 s steps. For each capsule/mesh pair return the earliest impact time in [0,1] within 1e-9, a contact normal, and a stable resting-contact classification (a second impact within 1e-7 of the first is the same contact, not a new collision) so a backstop simulation never tunnels through a 0.01-thick wall. Deliver a CLI that streams JSONL capsule states and prints one JSON line per state with time_of_impact, normal, triangle_id and classification, plus a --verify mode that re-checks every hit by sampling signed distance immediately before and after the reported impact time.
